decisions.reason: The gallery tab and secondary-content changes do not alter the independently stated mapping of service-page entries to relevant images.
Changing gallery categories and secondary content does not change the separate requirement that gallery items receive hover animations.
The gallery organization change is consistent with but does not modify the sitewide requirement for image-focused visual design.
The main-gallery category decision does not change the homepage design direction, hero-image emphasis, or overlay settings.
Gallery tabs and secondary photography content do not alter the itemized service-pricing layout or transparency rules.
The gallery organization change does not affect the one-time pricing model or the visibility of monthly and annual pricing tabs.
The gallery category decision does not modify the required number or presentation of package-pricing spaces.
The source modification concerns main-gallery categories and secondary content, not the independently specified basic animation for the homepage gallery.
References to photos and other services are gallery categories and do not change the deferred quote calculator's selection, pricing, or calculation behavior.
The gallery organization change does not alter the pricing-area navigation entry or its detailed-pricing destination.
